newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton ends up amid speculative shortcovering.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton ends up amid speculative shortcovering.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures ended higher on Friday, bolstered by technically-driven speculative short covering, analysts said.
"There are no fundamentals to justify this rally," said Sharon Johnson, cotton analyst with Frank Schneider and Co Inc. She noted massive buy stops were hit at 76.50 cents a lb, basis May.
"The funds have been short for several weeks," Johnson said. Once the market closed above key resistance at 76.00 cents, basis May, stops were triggered above 76.50. "It was a busy day," she said.
Volume was heavy about 28,500 lots changed hands.
May cotton at the close gained 0.87 cent at 76.92 cents a lb, trading between 77.15 and 76.30 cents. The rest of the board was 0.32 to 0.71 cent higher.
